Bug_Title: Typing / Search Filter is Not Enabled in District Dropdown
Description: The district selection element is implemented as a static native HTML <select> dropdown without an integrated search input field or autocomplete combobox. Users are forced to manually scroll.
Steps_to_Reproduce:
1. Navigate to Step 1: Administrative District.
2. Attempt to click into the select box and type 'Thanjavur' or 'Coimbatore'.
3. Observe that no search input opens and typing does not filter the list.
Expected_Behavior: A searchable combobox/autocomplete input should be available where a farmer can type 2-3 letters to instantly filter matching districts.
Actual_Behavior: No typing input is enabled. User is locked into native dropdown mode.
Impact_Analysis: High farmer friction. Farmers cannot quickly jump to their district by typing, resulting in frustration and drop-off.
Suggested_Remediation: Replace native <select> with a searchable React Combobox component (e.g. Radix UI or headless autocomplete with input filter).

Bug_Title: Only Static Dropdown is Enabled Causing Excessive Time Consumption Across 38 Districts
Description: Because only vertical dropdown scrolling is enabled, users have to scroll through up to 38 district names (from Ariyalur down to Virudhunagar) every time they want to select their region.
Steps_to_Reproduce:
1. Open the district dropdown.
2. Locate districts near the bottom (e.g., Tiruvarur, Vellore, Viluppuram, Virudhunagar).
3. Measure time and effort required to scroll down on mobile or trackpad.
Expected_Behavior: Districts should be grouped by Agro-Climatic Zone (Cauvery Delta, Western, Southern, etc.) or accessible via search/chips to minimize scroll time to < 2 seconds.
Actual_Behavior: Requires 8-15 seconds of repetitive continuous scrolling through an unsegmented 38-item single vertical list.
Impact_Analysis: Severe usability issue for rural farmers and extension officers conducting high-volume field evaluations.
Suggested_Remediation: Implement zonal optgroups or quick-filter category chips ('Delta', 'Western', 'Coastal', 'Southern') to prune scroll length by 75%.

Bug_Title: Single-Key Jump Only Moves to First Letter, Failing Multi-Character String Matching
Description: Native dropdown type-ahead only captures a single key press. Typing 'TH' rapidly does not jump to 'Thanjavur'; instead 'T' jumps to 'Tenkasi' and 'H' fails or jumps erratically.
Steps_to_Reproduce:
1. Focus the district dropdown using Tab key.
2. Rapidly type 'T-H-A'.
3. Observe which district is selected.
Expected_Behavior: Smart multi-character fuzzy type-ahead should instantly match 'Thanjavur'.
Actual_Behavior: Focus jumps to 'Tenkasi' on 'T' and drops subsequent key strokes.
Impact_Analysis: Makes keyboard-only navigation unreliable and misleading for desktop users.
Suggested_Remediation: Implement debounce buffer in keydown listener to match complete substring queries.

Bug_Title: Lack of 'Recent / Favorite Districts' Pinned at the Top of the Selector
Description: Farmers almost always operate in their home district or neighboring tract. Currently, the dropdown resets to alphabetical top on every session with no pin/history.
Steps_to_Reproduce:
1. Select 'Virudhunagar'.
2. Reload the page or close and reopen app.
3. Observe that user must scroll all the way to the bottom again.
Expected_Behavior: The 2-3 most recently selected districts or a 'Pinned Home District' should appear at the top of the dropdown for 1-click access.
Actual_Behavior: No local caching of favorite/recent districts; user repeats full 38-district search every session.
Impact_Analysis: Increases cumulative interaction overhead for daily agricultural monitoring.
Suggested_Remediation: Store last 3 selected district IDs in window.localStorage and render a 'Recent Districts' section atop dropdown.

Bug_Title: Dropdown Option Row Height is Under 48px, Leading to Accidental Mis-clicks in the Field
Description: On touchscreens (tablets, rugged field laptops), the native select options have dense default line spacing (~28-32px), causing accidental selection of adjacent districts.
Steps_to_Reproduce:
1. Open app on a touchscreen tablet or simulate touch in DevTools.
2. Attempt to tap 'Tiruchirappalli' with a finger.
3. Frequently triggers 'Tirunelveli' or 'Tirupathur' instead.
Expected_Behavior: Touch targets must comply with WCAG 2.5.5 target size recommendation (minimum 44x44px or 48px padding).
Actual_Behavior: Compact native desktop height makes precise finger touch difficult with dirty/gloved farmer hands.
Impact_Analysis: Farmers accidentally evaluate the wrong soil profile due to fat-finger mis-clicks.
Suggested_Remediation: Use a custom dropdown menu with min-height: 48px per row and generous padding.

Bug_Title: Absence of Loading / Pulse Transition Skeleton While Factsheet Data Renders
Description: When a new district is selected, the factsheet metrics update instantly without any visual feedback, subtle animation, or transition skeleton. Farmers are left unsure if the data actually changed.
Steps_to_Reproduce:
1. Select 'Thanjavur' (Cauvery Delta).
2. Switch to 'Tiruvarur' (also Cauvery Delta with similar alluvial data).
3. Look at factsheet card.
Expected_Behavior: A 150ms gentle shimmer/fade transition or highlight flash should confirm that the new regional soil data was fetched.
Actual_Behavior: Zero transition cues. Numbers change instantaneously with no visual acknowledgement.
Impact_Analysis: Users click the dropdown multiple times believing the system did not respond.
Suggested_Remediation: Add a CSS cross-fade or pulse transition keyframe on data update in DistrictSelector.jsx.

Bug_Title: English-Only Dropdown Traps Users when Searching Tamil Phonetics
Description: When operating in Tamil mode, typing English letters or English phonetics does not resolve to Tamil district entries.
Steps_to_Reproduce:
1. Toggle language to 'தமிழ்'.
2. Open dropdown and type 'M-A-D-U-R-A-I'.
3. System fails to jump to 'மதுரை'.
Expected_Behavior: Bilingual dual-index search should match both English transliteration ('Madurai') and Tamil Unicode ('மதுரை').
Actual_Behavior: Type-ahead fails completely when keyboard layout does not match active interface language.
Impact_Analysis: Rural farmers using bilingual keyboards cannot navigate efficiently.
Suggested_Remediation: Implement normalized dual-key search dictionary matching both Latin and Tamil character streams.

Bug_Title: Long District Names Truncate Abruptly on Mobile and Narrow Viewports
Description: District display strings format as '{Name} ({Zone})' (e.g., 'Thanjavur (Cauvery Delta ('Rice Bowl of Tamil Nadu'))'). On screen widths < 768px, text truncates with ellipsis without tooltip.
Steps_to_Reproduce:
1. Resize browser window to mobile width (375px - 414px).
2. Open Step 1 District selector.
3. Observe that zone details are clipped: 'Thanjavur (Cauvery Delta ('Rice...'.
Expected_Behavior: District name should display on primary line with agro-climatic zone rendered as a secondary subtitle badge.
Actual_Behavior: Long combined strings overflow the select container and clip crucial agronomic zone text.
Impact_Analysis: Farmers cannot read the complete agro-climatic zone label on mobile devices.

Bug_Title: Factsheet Text Contrast Ratio is Insufficient Under Bright Outdoor Sun Conditions
Description: The soil factsheet uses gold-accent minor text and muted gray descriptions on dark emerald backgrounds, which washes out under direct sunlight in farmland fields.
Steps_to_Reproduce:
1. Take laptop outdoors or simulate high ambient daylight / contrast wash.
2. Attempt to read 'Sand & Mineral Geology' description.
3. Text is difficult to decipher without shielding the screen.
Expected_Behavior: Text contrast ratio should exceed 7:1 (WCAG AAA) for high-visibility agricultural outdoor use.
Actual_Behavior: Muted minor text has contrast ratio of ~4.2:1, borderline under bright sunlight.
Impact_Analysis: Farmers inspecting soil profiles in open fields struggle to read technical soil composition data.
Suggested_Remediation: Provide an 'Outdoor High Contrast / Day Mode' toggle with crisp white/black typography.

Bug_Title: No Side-by-Side Soil Profile Comparison for Bordering Districts
Description: Farmers with land near district borders (e.g., Thanjavur / Tiruvarur or Coimbatore / Tiruppur) have to constantly switch back and forth to compare soil profiles.
Steps_to_Reproduce:
1. Select District A; memorize soil pH and rainfall.
2. Select District B; previous data disappears immediately.
3. User has to toggle back and forth repeatedly.
Expected_Behavior: An optional 'Compare with Neighboring District' toggle allowing side-by-side factsheets.
Actual_Behavior: Single-district view only; no comparative agronomic analysis available.
Impact_Analysis: Limits agronomic decision-making for border farmlands.
Suggested_Remediation: Add a secondary comparison drawer or split-view mode in the UI.

Bug_Title: Updated Soil Profile Factsheet Lacks ARIA Live Region for Voice Announcements
Description: When a visually impaired user or farmer using screen reader software selects a district, the factsheet card updates silently without triggering an aria-live announcement.
Steps_to_Reproduce:
1. Enable Windows Narrator or NVDA screen reader.
2. Navigate to district dropdown and select 'Madurai'.
3. Observe that screen reader does not read out the newly loaded soil profile.
Expected_Behavior: The factsheet container should have role='status' or aria-live='polite' to announce: 'Soil profile loaded for Madurai: Red Sandy Loam, 840 mm rainfall'.
Actual_Behavior: Card container has no ARIA live markup; screen reader remains silent.
Impact_Analysis: Blocks accessibility for farmers with visual impairments.
Suggested_Remediation: Add aria-live='polite' and aria-atomic='true' to .district-factsheet element.

Bug_Title: Mouse Wheel Scrolling Over Focused Dropdown Unintentionally Swaps Districts
Description: If the farmer scrolls down the webpage while their mouse cursor passes over the focused dropdown, the browser intercepts the scroll event and changes the district.
Steps_to_Reproduce:
1. Click the district dropdown once to focus it, then click outside to close.
2. Place mouse pointer over the dropdown and scroll mouse wheel down to reach Step 2.
3. Notice that the district changes automatically without user intent.
Expected_Behavior: Mouse wheel events should scroll the webpage, not silently modify the selected district unless the dropdown list is actively open.
Actual_Behavior: Focused select element captures wheel event and alters farmer's district selection silently.
Impact_Analysis: Farmers accidentally evaluate the wrong district without realizing the selection changed.
Suggested_Remediation: Call e.target.blur() after selection or intercept wheel events on inactive select.

Bug_Title: Absence of 'Detect My District via GPS / Offline Cell Tower' One-Click Option
Description: The application lacks an auto-detect button to identify the farmer's current district using device coordinates or offline district mapping.
Steps_to_Reproduce:
1. Farmer opens application in field.
2. No option to auto-detect location.
3. Farmer must know their exact administrative district name and locate it in the list.
Expected_Behavior: A '📍 Detect Current District' button that queries navigator.geolocation and auto-selects the nearest Tamil Nadu district.
Actual_Behavior: 100% manual selection required; zero geolocation integration.
Impact_Analysis: Added friction for farm workers and tenant farmers unfamiliar with administrative boundaries.
Suggested_Remediation: Integrate offline reverse-geocoding coordinates boundary box matching Tamil Nadu district polygons.

Bug_Title: Soil Factsheet Lacks Offline Download / Print Summary Feature
Description: Once a district's soil profile is loaded, there is no button to save, print, or share a 1-page PDF/image soil advisory card for field use.
Steps_to_Reproduce:
1. Select 'Dharmapuri' and view factsheet.
2. Attempt to save or print the soil summary.
3. No export option exists; user must take manual screenshot.
Expected_Behavior: A '📄 Save Soil Factsheet (PDF)' or 'Print Soil Card' button on the factsheet card.
Actual_Behavior: Data is only viewable in the live active DOM.
Impact_Analysis: Farmers cannot print or share physical soil advisories with village cooperative banks or field workers.
Suggested_Remediation: Add window.print() CSS stylesheet styled specifically for single-page soil factsheet.

Bug_Title: Absence of a Reset Button to Clear District Selection Back to State Overview
Description: Once a district is selected, there is no 'Clear Selection' or 'Overview' option to deselect and view statewide Tamil Nadu agricultural averages.
Steps_to_Reproduce:
1. Select any district.
2. Try to deselect it to return to initial prompt or statewide view.
3. Dropdown has no null/empty option; selection cannot be cleared without hard refresh.
Expected_Behavior: A reset button or an option: '-- Select District (Statewide Overview) --'.
Actual_Behavior: User is permanently locked into a single district once chosen.
Impact_Analysis: Minor usability defect when farmers want to compare their farm against statewide benchmarks.
Suggested_Remediation: Add a 'Reset / View All Tamil Nadu' action button alongside the district badge.
